rationale: C11 is a direct and material drafting antecedent. It amends the same Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees under the same section V-15 and 22 CFR 103.1 authority, using nearly identical language. It also supplies the child's clause amending inconsistent prior Executive orders and a closely parallel publication-based effective-date clause. The child is effectively a shorter subsequent amendment built from C11's drafting machinery. C03 and C06 share only general amendment or effective-date structures and are much weaker.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees, prescribed by section V-15 of the Foreign Service Regulations of the United States ([DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], as amended; 22 CFR 103.1), is amended by deleting therefrom Items No. 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Tariff of United States Foreign Service Fees, prescribed by section V-15 of the Foreign Service Regulations of the United States ([DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], as amended; 22 CFR 103.1), is amended as follows:
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim language identifying the same tariff, regulatory section, codified provision, and amendment mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All prior Executive orders inconsistent herewith are amended accordingly.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All prior Executive orders inconsistent herewith are amended accordingly.
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces this operative clause verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall become effective ten days after the date of its publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except as otherwise provided herein, this order shall become effective as of the date of its publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same publication-triggered effective-date formulation, with the child adapting the timing to ten days after publication.
